text: After a childhood car crash leaves her with a titanium plate in her skull, Alexia [embraces the family car with passion|trigger|love and desire] and grows up to be a showgirl at motor shows, who [kills with her metal hair stick|threat|the enemy within]. After sex with a Cadillac she finds motor oil leaking from her body and [a pregnancy she cannot end|rules|the body changes]. On the run, she binds her belly, breaks her own nose and poses as a fire captain's long-lost son, and Vincent, [aging and grieving|who_suffers|the grieving], accepts her without question.
